From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed next steps

Hi Sarah / Alex —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through HealthSync's current inference pain points and the compliance constraints you mentioned. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Key needs you shared: predictable inference latency for patient-facing features, VPC isolation for PHI workflows, and an eval plan for cost/quality tradeoffs.
- Internal sponsor: Alex mentioned that Dr. Rivera (ops) will need to sign off on the security posture before a POC.
- Success criteria: <10% latency p95 improvement vs current baseline, SOC2 evidence, and a one-week smoke POC.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Technical deep-dive (60 min) with your infra + our SEs to validate infra access and runbook (we can demo a small latency test).
2) Share the mutual action plan & security questionnaire for sponsor review.
3) Schedule a short follow-up with legal/procurement when sponsor gives the thumbs up.

Proposed deep-dive slots (PST):
- Tue 5/4, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 5/5, 11:00–12:00

Can you confirm which slot works best and who from HealthSync will attend (names + roles)? Once you confirm, I will send a calendar invite with the Zoom bridge and attach the mutual action plan + security questionnaire answers for review.

Thanks,

Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks, Irene — great summary.

We can confirm Wed 5/5 11:00–12:00 PT for the deep-dive. Attendees from HealthSync:
- Alex Rivera (Director, Infrastructure)
- Sarah Patel (Product Manager) — myself
- Priya Desai (Security lead) — will try to join, may be on a call for the first 30 minutes only

Sponsor approval path: Alex will review the security questionnaire and then loop in Legal if anything looks risky. If Priya can’t join the full hour we still want the session recorded and a short follow-up with Priya. 

Please send the calendar invite + Zoom link and include the mutual action plan and the security questionnaire so Alex can circulate to our sponsor.

Best,
Sarah
